findings.one_line: The joint-TV condition is an estimator-determined transfer conclusion in hypothesis form: the offered sample-split condition merely assumes the conditional Gaussian-TV approximation that yields gamma_n, with no primitive model/rate argument establishing it; discharge it from a named construction or explicitly re-scope the feasible-transfer proposition as conditional on this open premise.

The reproduced proof of prop:conditional-tie-uniform-transfer uses only the reverse kernel bound L_n N(h,Sigma) approximately P_{n,h} in (13); its forward K_n half is never consumed because the upper transfer is supplied independently by ass:joint-risk-transfer. State the needed reverse deficiency condition (and its error) rather than the materially stronger two-sided equivalence.
